entities.name: Cisco
entities.gloss: An American multinational technology company specializing in networking hardware, software, and telecommunications equipment.

entities.name: Cisco Discovery Protocol
entities.gloss: A proprietary Data Link Layer network protocol developed by Cisco to share information between directly connected Cisco devices.

entities.name: CDPwn
entities.gloss: A group of five high-severity vulnerabilities affecting Cisco Discovery Protocol implementations across various Cisco products.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3120
entities.gloss: A denial-of-service vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco FXOS, IOS XR, and NX-OS.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3119
entities.gloss: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco NX-OS.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3118
entities.gloss: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco IOS XR.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3111
entities.gloss: A remote code execution and denial-of-service vulnerability in Cisco IP Phones using Cisco Discovery Protocol.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3110
entities.gloss: A remote code execution and denial-of-service vulnerability in Cisco 8000 Series IP Cameras using Cisco Discovery Protocol.

entities.name: Cisco FXOS
entities.gloss: An operating system developed by Cisco for its Firepower series security appliances.

entities.name: Cisco IOS XR
entities.gloss: A train of Cisco Systems' Internetworking Operating System (IOS) designed for carrier-grade network routers.

entities.name: Cisco NX-OS
entities.gloss: A network operating system developed by Cisco Systems for Nexus series Ethernet switches.

entities.name: IP-телефон Cisco IP
entities.gloss: A line of Voice over IP (VoIP) telephony devices manufactured by Cisco Systems.

entities.name: IP-камери Cisco для відеоспостереження серії 8000
entities.gloss: A series of high-definition network video surveillance cameras developed by Cisco Systems.
